excluded_evidence_note: Original verification.json hashes include private ownership/GO/cache/release records. Publisher must mark those as intentionally omitted, not claim every referenced artifact is included.
sanitization_rules: Publish separate original_sha256 and public_sha256 for every changed file; never pretend the sanitized file was the measured original.
Command fields may become repository-relative placeholders; remove PID, PGID and private machine/cache/user fields.
Do not rewrite original identity-reference hashes to public-file hashes as though those checks ran against the sanitized files. Preserve a provenance map.

The frozen runner uses original workspace paths and dependency identities; archive it as original reproduction code. Any portable relocation adapter must be marked a new derived script and must not imply it was the measured controller.
If excluding ownership/GO/preflight records, update public explanatory text accordingly; preserve measured scores and raw stdout/stderr exactly.
No raw dataset input is duplicated in this source archive; use fixed stat_dataset manifest plus compressed inputs in datasets.
